description: Generate a table of contents from a TOC style and place it on a page, or update the one already in the document (Layout > Table of Contents, Layout > Update Table of Contents). Can take entries from every document of a book and make the table interactive (PDF bookmarks and links).

bookPath.description: Build the table from every document of this book (.indb); the book is opened if needed

interactive.description: Make the table interactive: PDF bookmarks and anchors to the source paragraphs, and turn on bookmarks and hyperlinks in PDF export

layer.description: Layer to place it on (default: the active layer)

replaceExisting.description: Update (replace) the table of contents already generated with this style

x.description: Left edge in mm from the page's left edge (default: the left margin)

y.description: Top edge in mm from the page's top edge (default: the top margin)

name: create_toc
title: Create Toc
